## What changed

- Fixed automatically detected compact sizing remaining active after a constrained Home Assistant preview or dashboard area becomes taller.
- Auto-height cards now reassess their natural layout whenever their available size changes. They enter compact mode only while the normal layout would clip or overflow, and return to normal sizing as soon as the content fits again.
- Preserved explicit fixed-row behavior: cards configured with a numeric grid-row height continue to use the existing height-aware scaling at all times.
- Added a real-browser regression test covering the full resize cycle: constrained, expanded, and constrained again.

## Compatibility

No configuration or SaltWatch firmware changes are required. Existing cards update in place through HACS. All established tank, details, typography, divider, marker, mobile, and fixed-grid sizing rules remain unchanged.

## Validation

- 37 unit tests passed.
- 33 browser tests passed across desktop and mobile profiles; one desktop-only mobile-scroll test was skipped as intended.
- Confirmed an auto-height card enters compact mode at 220 px, exits it after expanding to 720 px, and re-enters it when reduced to 220 px again on both desktop and mobile.
- Confirmed explicit fixed-row layouts still remain height-aware and all content stays inside the assigned card height.
- Production TypeScript and Vite builds passed.
